description: Reference data of the molecular dynamics of Fortran PARSEC. usrinputfile.F90, initial.f90 and moldyn.f90 were compiled unchanged and driven by md_harness.f90 with an analytic Morse cluster in place of the self-consistent field. Kinetic energies and temperatures ('energy') come from a copy of moldyn.f90 with one inserted WRITE statement, which leaves every state and file identical; the restart cases use a copy of initial.f90 whose input format 20 reads (6x,i4) because gfortran rejects the distributed ('Step #',i4). Numbers were written with 17 significant digits and are exact doubles. For a cluster the positions moldyn returns (clust%xatm) equal xcur bit for bit, so only xcur is stored. Two more identities were checked on the Fortran data and are not stored: xold after a call equals xcur before it, and every self-consistent field after the first is evaluated at the xcur of the previous call ('positions' is therefore given for the first step only).

morse.comment: E = sum_{i<j} D[(1-exp(-a(r-r0)))^2 - 1], Ry and bohr; pair parameters indexed by the two species

harness_sources.comment: The driver programs and the build script that produced this file; the PARSEC sources are taken unchanged from the PARSEC distribution (SHA-256 above).
harness_sources.build.sh:
#!/bin/bash
# Build the molecular dynamics harness from the unchanged PARSEC sources.
#
#   md_harness            every PARSEC file exactly as distributed
#   md_harness_instr      moldyn.f90 with ONE inserted WRITE statement after
#                         the computation of tcalc (line 559), so that the
#                         kinetic energy and the temperature are available
#                         with 17 digits
#   md_harness_rst        initial.f90 with format 20 changed from
#                         ('Step #',i4) to (6x,i4); gfortran refuses a
#                         character constant in an input format, so the
#                         distributed file cannot read mdinit.dat at all
#   md_harness_rst_instr  both changes
#
# Usage: build.sh [optimisation flag, default -O0] [build directory tag]
set -e
HERE=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)
SRC=$(cd "$HERE/../../fortran_src/src" && pwd)
OPT=${1:--O0}
TAG=${2:-}
BUILD=$HERE/build$TAG
mkdir -p "$BUILD"
cd "$BUILD"
rm -f *.o *.mod

FLAGS="-cpp -DGFORTRAN $OPT -fallow-argument-mismatch -ffree-line-length-none -w -I$SRC"

sha256sum "$SRC/moldyn.f90" "$SRC/initial.f90" "$SRC/usrinputfile.F90" \
          "$SRC/structures.F90" "$SRC/const.f90" "$SRC/ptable.f90" \
          "$SRC/esdf_mod.f90" "$SRC/esdf_key_mod.f90" > sources.sha256
gfortran --version | head -1 > compiler.txt
echo "$FLAGS" | sed "s#$SRC#SRC#" >> compiler.txt

for f in const.f90 structures.F90 esdf_key_mod.f90 esdf_mod.f90 \
         usrinputfile.F90 initial.f90 moldyn.f90 myflush.F90 ptable.f90 \
         exit_err.F90 symgen.f90 inipbc.f90 wfnsave.F90; do
    gfortran $FLAGS -c "$SRC/$f" -o "${f%.*}.o"
done
gfortran $FLAGS -c "$HERE/stubs.f90" -o stubs.o
gfortran $FLAGS -c "$HERE/md_harness.f90" -o md_harness.o

COMMON="const.o structures.o esdf_key_mod.o esdf_mod.o usrinputfile.o \
        myflush.o ptable.o exit_err.o symgen.o inipbc.o wfnsave.o stubs.o"

gfortran $OPT -o md_harness md_harness.o moldyn.o initial.o $COMMON -lblas

# instrumented copy of moldyn.f90: one inserted line, nothing else
sed "559r $HERE/instrument_line.txt" "$SRC/moldyn.f90" > moldyn_instr.f90
diff "$SRC/moldyn.f90" moldyn_instr.f90 > moldyn_instr.diff || true
gfortran $FLAGS -c moldyn_instr.f90 -o moldyn_instr.o
gfortran $OPT -o md_harness_instr md_harness.o moldyn_instr.o initial.o $COMMON -lblas

# copy of initial.f90 that can read mdinit.dat when compiled by gfortran
sed "s/^20 format('Step #',i4)/20 format(6x,i4)/" "$SRC/initial.f90" > initial_rst.f90
diff "$SRC/initial.f90" initial_rst.f90 > initial_rst.diff || true
gfortran $FLAGS -c initial_rst.f90 -o initial_rst.o
gfortran $OPT -o md_harness_rst md_harness.o moldyn.o initial_rst.o $COMMON -lblas
gfortran $OPT -o md_harness_rst_instr md_harness.o moldyn_instr.o initial_rst.o $COMMON -lblas

gfortran $FLAGS "$HERE/format_probe.f90" -o format_probe
./format_probe > format_probe.out

# the random number functions of moldyn.f90 on their own
gfortran $FLAGS -c "$HERE/gdev_probe.f90" -o gdev_probe.o
gfortran $OPT -o gdev_probe gdev_probe.o moldyn.o initial.o $COMMON -lblas

# every name of ptable.f90, and a few it does not know
gfortran $FLAGS "$HERE/ptable_probe.f90" const.o ptable.o -o ptable_probe
sed -n "/^subroutine ptable/,/^end subroutine ptable/p" "$SRC/ptable.f90" \
    | grep -o "element == '..'" | sed "s/element == '\(..\)'/\1/" > ptable_names.txt
printf 'Pm\nXx\nsi\nSI\nh \nD \n  \nHe\n' >> ptable_names.txt
./ptable_probe < ptable_names.txt > ptable_probe.out
rm -f fort.7

echo "built in $BUILD with $OPT"
cat moldyn_instr.diff initial_rst.diff
harness_sources.md_harness.f90:
!===============================================================
! Stand-alone driver for the ORIGINAL PARSEC molecular dynamics.
!
! It links, unchanged:
!   const.f90, structures.F90 (all PARSEC modules), esdf_key_mod.f90,
!   esdf_mod.f90, usrinputfile.F90 (subroutine usrinput), initial.f90
!   (subroutines initial and back_to_cell), moldyn.f90 (moldyn, gdev,
!   getrandom, get_rand_test), ptable.f90, myflush.F90, exit_err.F90
!   (alccheck), symgen.f90 (mtrxin), inipbc.f90 (matvec3) and
!   wfnsave.F90 (custom_date_time).
!
! The driver follows parsec.F90: init_* of every structure, usrinput
! (reads parsec.in of the current directory), the three lines of
! pseudo.f90 that set clust%amass from ptable, create_movement,
! initial, and then the atom movement loop with the self-consistent
! field replaced by an analytic Morse cluster:
!
!   30  forces and total energy at clust%{x,y,z}atm
!       bdev = rydberg*etot/natom           (totnrg.f90)
!       if (step_num == 0) goto 80
!       call moldyn(clust,mol_dynamic,pbc,move%num,bdev)
!       if (move%num > step_num) goto 80
!       goto 30
!   80  continue
!
! Everything moldyn keeps in mol_dynamic is written with 17
! significant digits to harness_dump.txt after every call.
!===============================================================
program md_harness

  use constants
  use cluster_module
  use electronic_struct_module
  use grid_module
  use potential_module
  use pseudo_potential_module
  use molecular_dynamic_module
  use pbc_module
  use mixer_module
  use eigen_solver_module
  use movement_module
  use bandstruc_module
  use nscf_module
  implicit none

  type (cluster) :: clust
  type (electronic_struct) :: elec_st
  type (bandstruc) :: band_st
  type (nscf_data) :: nscf
  type (grid_data) :: grid
  type (pseudo_potential) :: p_pot
  type (molecular_dynamic) :: mol_dynamic
  type (pbc_data) :: pbc
  type (mixer_data) :: mixer
  type (movement) :: move
  type (potential) :: pot
  type (eigen_solver) :: solver

  integer :: istart, mxiter, npolflg, outflag, ipr, ngroups, nnodes
  integer :: outevflag, file_id, ierr, ifield
  integer :: export_griddata_flag(MAX_EXPORT_OPTS)
  real(dp) :: vconv, vconv_approach, field, wstrt, elval, bdev, etot, am
  logical :: chsym, oldinpformat, readwfndat, ignoresym, outputgw
  logical :: enable_data_out
  integer :: ity, k, kk, j, ncall
  integer, allocatable :: itype(:)
  integer, parameter :: du = 50

  ierr = 0
  nnodes = 1
  file_id = 0
  wstrt = zero
  export_griddata_flag = 0

  open(du,file='harness_dump.txt',form='formatted',status='unknown')
  ! unit written only by the instrumented copy of moldyn.f90
  open(51,file='harness_energy.txt',form='formatted',status='unknown')

  ! as in parsec.F90
  call init_cluster(clust)
  call init_electronic_struct(elec_st)
  call init_grid(grid)
  call init_pseudo_potential(p_pot)
  call init_molecular_dynamic(mol_dynamic)
  call init_mixer(mixer)
  call init_pbc(pbc)
  call init_movement(move)
  call init_nscf(nscf)
  call init_potential(pot)

  call usrinput(clust,band_st,elec_st,grid, &
       pot,p_pot,mol_dynamic,pbc,mixer,solver,move,istart, &
       mxiter,vconv,vconv_approach,npolflg,field,outflag,ipr, &
       export_griddata_flag,chsym, &
       ngroups,nnodes,wstrt,nscf, &
       oldinpformat,outevflag,readwfndat,ignoresym,outputgw, &
       enable_data_out,file_id,ierr)
  write(du,'(a,i6)') 'usrinput_ierr ', ierr
  if (ierr /= 0) goto 90

  call create_movement(move)

  ! pseudo.f90, lines 127-140: atomic masses from the periodic table
  k = 1
  allocate(itype(clust%atom_num))
  do ity = 1, clust%type_num
     call ptable(clust%name(ity),am,ierr)
     if (ierr /= 0) then
        write(du,'(a,i6)') 'ptable_ierr ', ierr
        goto 90
     endif
     do kk = k, k + clust%natmi(ity) - 1
        clust%amass(kk) = am*1836.d0
        itype(kk) = ity
     enddo
     k = k + clust%natmi(ity)
  enddo
  elval = 8.d0

  call initial(clust,elec_st,pbc,mol_dynamic,move,elval,npolflg,field, &
       ifield,istart,outevflag,grid%domain_shape,ierr)
  write(du,'(a,i6)') 'initial_ierr ', ierr
  if (ierr /= 0) goto 90

  write(du,'(a,l2)') 'is_on ', mol_dynamic%is_on
  if (mol_dynamic%is_on) then
     write(du,'(a,i12)') 'cool_type ', mol_dynamic%cool_type
     write(du,'(a,i12)') 'step_num ', mol_dynamic%step_num
     if (mol_dynamic%cool_type == MD_STAIR) then
        write(du,'(a,i12)') 'stride ', mol_dynamic%stride
     else
        write(du,'(a,i12)') 'stride ', 0
     endif
     write(du,'(a,l2)') 'is_restart ', mol_dynamic%is_restart
     write(du,'(a,l2)') 'use_test_rng ', mol_dynamic%use_test_rng
     write(du,'(a,i12)') 'rng_seed ', mol_dynamic%rng_seed
     write(du,'(a,i12)') 'nrandom ', mol_dynamic%nrandom
     write(du,'(a,i12)') 'iframe ', mol_dynamic%iframe
     write(du,'(a,es25.17e3)') 'tempi ', mol_dynamic%tempi
     write(du,'(a,es25.17e3)') 'tempf ', mol_dynamic%tempf
     write(du,'(a,es25.17e3)') 'step_tmp ', mol_dynamic%step_tmp
     write(du,'(a,es25.17e3)') 'tscale ', mol_dynamic%tscale
     write(du,'(a,es25.17e3)') 'time_step ', mol_dynamic%time_step
     write(du,'(a,es25.17e3)') 'friction_coef ', mol_dynamic%friction_coef
  endif
  write(du,'(a,i12)') 'natom ', clust%atom_num
  write(du,'(a,i12)') 'ntype ', clust%type_num
  do j = 1, clust%atom_num
     write(du,'(a,i6,1x,a2,1x,i3,1x,i3,4es25.17e3)') 'atom ', j, &
          clust%name(itype(j)), itype(j), clust%mvat(j), clust%amass(j), &
          clust%xatm(j), clust%yatm(j), clust%zatm(j)
  enddo
  if (mol_dynamic%is_on .and. mol_dynamic%is_restart) then
     do j = 1, clust%atom_num
        write(du,'(a,i6,12es25.17e3)') 'state0 ', j, &
             mol_dynamic%xcur(j), mol_dynamic%ycur(j), mol_dynamic%zcur(j), &
             mol_dynamic%xold(j), mol_dynamic%yold(j), mol_dynamic%zold(j), &
             mol_dynamic%vxold(j), mol_dynamic%vyold(j), mol_dynamic%vzold(j), &
             mol_dynamic%accxold(j), mol_dynamic%accyold(j), &
             mol_dynamic%acczold(j)
     enddo
  else if (mol_dynamic%is_on) then
     ! without a restart only the positions are defined at this point;
     ! the other arrays are allocated and not yet assigned
     do j = 1, clust%atom_num
        write(du,'(a,i6,12es25.17e3)') 'state0 ', j, &
             mol_dynamic%xcur(j), mol_dynamic%ycur(j), mol_dynamic%zcur(j), &
             zero, zero, zero, zero, zero, zero, zero, zero, zero
     enddo
  endif

  ! ---------------------------------------------------------------
  ! atom movement loop of parsec.F90
  ! ---------------------------------------------------------------
  ncall = 0
30 continue
  call morse(clust%atom_num,itype,clust%xatm,clust%yatm,clust%zatm, &
       clust%force,etot)
  ! totnrg.f90: total energy per atom in eV
  bdev = rydberg*etot/real(clust%atom_num,dp)

  write(du,'(a,i8,i8,es25.17e3)') 'scf ', move%num, mol_dynamic%iframe, &
       mol_dynamic%tempi
  write(du,'(a,2es25.17e3)') 'energy ', etot, bdev
  do j = 1, clust%atom_num
     write(du,'(a,i6,6es25.17e3)') 'force ', j, clust%xatm(j), &
          clust%yatm(j), clust%zatm(j), clust%force(1,j), &
          clust%force(2,j), clust%force(3,j)
  enddo

  if ( (mol_dynamic%is_on) .and. (mol_dynamic%step_num == 0) ) goto 80
  if (.not. mol_dynamic%is_on) goto 80

  call moldyn(clust,mol_dynamic,pbc,move%num,bdev)
  ncall = ncall + 1

  write(du,'(a,i8,i8,es25.17e3,i12,i8)') 'after ', move%num, &
       mol_dynamic%iframe, mol_dynamic%tempi, mol_dynamic%rng_seed, &
       mol_dynamic%iset
  do j = 1, clust%atom_num
     write(du,'(a,i6,12es25.17e3)') 'state ', j, &
          mol_dynamic%xcur(j), mol_dynamic%ycur(j), mol_dynamic%zcur(j), &
          mol_dynamic%xold(j), mol_dynamic%yold(j), mol_dynamic%zold(j), &
          mol_dynamic%vxold(j), mol_dynamic%vyold(j), mol_dynamic%vzold(j), &
          mol_dynamic%accxold(j), mol_dynamic%accyold(j), &
          mol_dynamic%acczold(j)
  enddo
  do j = 1, clust%atom_num
     write(du,'(a,i6,3es25.17e3)') 'xatm ', j, clust%xatm(j), &
          clust%yatm(j), clust%zatm(j)
  enddo

  if ( (mol_dynamic%is_on) .and. &
       (move%num > mol_dynamic%step_num) ) goto 80
  goto 30

80 continue
  write(du,'(a,i8)') 'moldyn_calls ', ncall

90 continue
  write(du,'(a)') 'end'
  close(du)
  close(51)
  close(7)
  if (mol_dynamic%is_on .and. ierr == 0) then
     close(66)
     close(78)
     close(79)
     close(92)
  endif

contains

  !---------------------------------------------------------------
  ! Morse cluster, energies in Ry and lengths in bohr:
  !   E = sum_{i<j} D [ (1 - exp(-a (r - r0)))**2 - 1 ]
  ! with parameters that depend on the two atom types.
  ! force(:,i) = -dE/dr_i  [Ry/bohr], the unit of clust%force.
  !---------------------------------------------------------------
  subroutine morse(natom,itype,x,y,z,force,etot)
    integer, intent(in) :: natom
    integer, intent(in) :: itype(natom)
    real(dp), intent(in) :: x(natom), y(natom), z(natom)
    real(dp), intent(out) :: force(3,natom)
    real(dp), intent(out) :: etot
    real(dp) :: dpar(2,2), apar(2,2), rpar(2,2)
    real(dp) :: dx, dy, dz, r, ex, de, fr
    integer :: i, j, ti, tj

    dpar(1,1) = 0.20d0; dpar(1,2) = 0.30d0
    dpar(2,1) = 0.30d0; dpar(2,2) = 0.05d0
    apar(1,1) = 0.90d0; apar(1,2) = 1.10d0
    apar(2,1) = 1.10d0; apar(2,2) = 1.30d0
    rpar(1,1) = 4.20d0; rpar(1,2) = 2.90d0
    rpar(2,1) = 2.90d0; rpar(2,2) = 3.40d0

    force = zero
    etot = zero
    do i = 1, natom - 1
       do j = i + 1, natom
          ti = min(itype(i),2)
          tj = min(itype(j),2)
          dx = x(i) - x(j)
          dy = y(i) - y(j)
          dz = z(i) - z(j)
          r = sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy + dz*dz)
          ex = exp(-apar(ti,tj)*(r - rpar(ti,tj)))
          etot = etot + dpar(ti,tj)*((one - ex)*(one - ex) - one)
          de = two*dpar(ti,tj)*apar(ti,tj)*(one - ex)*ex
          fr = -de/r
          force(1,i) = force(1,i) + fr*dx
          force(2,i) = force(2,i) + fr*dy
          force(3,i) = force(3,i) + fr*dz
          force(1,j) = force(1,j) - fr*dx
          force(2,j) = force(2,j) - fr*dy
          force(3,j) = force(3,j) - fr*dz
       enddo
    enddo
  end subroutine morse

end program md_harness

!===============================================================
! Routines referenced by structures.F90 for periodic systems and MPI
! bookkeeping.  The molecular dynamics harness never reaches them; each
! stub stops the program if it is called after all.
!===============================================================
subroutine fourier_f()
  write(*,*) 'HARNESS ERROR: stub fourier_f called'
  stop 97
end subroutine fourier_f

subroutine g_space()
  write(*,*) 'HARNESS ERROR: stub g_space called'
  stop 97
end subroutine g_space

  write(*,*) 'HARNESS ERROR: stub pisum called'
  stop 97
end subroutine pisum

harness_sources.format_probe.f90:
!===============================================================
! Prints numbers through every edit descriptor that the PARSEC molecular
! dynamics files use, so that the Python formatters can be compared with
! the Fortran run-time library character for character, including field
! overflow, signed zero, NaN and infinity.
!===============================================================
program format_probe
  implicit none
  integer, parameter :: dp = kind(1.0d0)
  integer, parameter :: nval = 46
  real(dp) :: v(nval), zero, r13(13)
  integer :: i, ios, iv(12), k
  character(len=40) :: buf
  character(len=220) :: line

  zero = 0.0d0
  v(1) = 0.0d0
  v(2) = -0.0d0
  v(3) = 1.0d0
  v(4) = -1.0d0
  v(5) = 0.125d0
  v(6) = -0.125d0
  v(7) = 0.5d0
  v(8) = 0.0005d0
  v(9) = 0.0015d0
  v(10) = 0.0025d0
  v(11) = 1.0005d0
  v(12) = 0.005d0
  v(13) = 0.015d0
  v(14) = 0.000005d0
  v(15) = 0.0000005d0
  v(16) = -1.0d-9
  v(17) = 1.0d-9
  v(18) = 3.1415926535897932d0
  v(19) = -3.1415926535897932d0
  v(20) = 123456.789d0
  v(21) = -12345.678d0
  v(22) = 9999.994d0
  v(23) = 9999.995d0
  v(24) = 9999.996d0
  v(25) = 99999.995d0
  v(26) = 999.9994d0
  v(27) = 999.9996d0
  v(28) = -999.9996d0
  v(29) = 1.0d7
  v(30) = -1.0d7
  v(31) = 1.0d-100
  v(32) = -1.0d-100
  v(33) = 1.0d100
  v(34) = -1.0d100
  v(35) = 9.99999995d0
  v(36) = 0.999999995d0
  v(37) = 0.0999999995d0
  v(38) = 2000.0d0
  v(39) = 0.25851d0
  v(40) = -982.98715d0
  v(41) = 1.0d0/zero
  v(42) = -1.0d0/zero
  v(43) = zero/zero
  v(44) = 4.94065645841246544d-324
  v(45) = 1.7976931348623157d308
  v(46) = 0.99999999d-5

  do i = 1, nval
     write(*,'(a,es25.17e3,a,f7.3,a)') 'F7.3   ', v(i), ' |', v(i), '|'
     write(*,'(a,es25.17e3,a,f7.2,a)') 'F7.2   ', v(i), ' |', v(i), '|'
     write(*,'(a,es25.17e3,a,f11.5,a)') 'F11.5  ', v(i), ' |', v(i), '|'
     write(*,'(a,es25.17e3,a,f11.6,a)') 'F11.6  ', v(i), ' |', v(i), '|'
     write(*,'(a,es25.17e3,a,f14.9,a)') 'F14.9  ', v(i), ' |', v(i), '|'
     write(*,'(a,es25.17e3,a,f10.6,a)') 'F10.6  ', v(i), ' |', v(i), '|'
     write(*,'(a,es25.17e3,a,e15.8,a)') 'E15.8  ', v(i), ' |', v(i), '|'
  enddo

  iv = (/ 0, 1, -1, 9, 10, 999, 1000, 9999, 10000, -999, -1000, 123456789 /)
  do i = 1, 12
     write(*,'(a,i12,a,i4,a)') 'I4     ', iv(i), ' |', iv(i), '|'
     write(*,'(a,i12,a,i3,a)') 'I3     ', iv(i), ' |', iv(i), '|'
     write(line,*) 'Coordinates for step #', iv(i)
     write(*,'(a,i12,a,a,a)') 'LIST   ', iv(i), ' |', trim(line), '|'
  enddo

  ! list-directed records exactly as initial.f90 and moldyn.f90 write them
  write(line,*) 'Step # ', 7
  write(*,'(a,a,a)') 'LSTEP  |', trim(line), '|'
  write(line,*) 'Step #', 7
  write(*,'(a,a,a)') 'LSTEP2 |', trim(line), '|'
  write(line,*) 'Ag'
  write(*,'(a,a,a)') 'LNAME  |', line(1:len_trim(line)), '|'
  write(line,*) 'H '
  write(*,'(a,a,a,i4)') 'LNAME2 |', line(1:4), '|', len_trim(line)
  write(line,*) ' Coordinates for next Run '
  write(*,'(a,a,a,i4)') 'LNEXT  |', line(1:30), '|', len_trim(line)

  ! reading back: the restart file is read with format(13(1x,e15.8))
  buf = ' 0.12345678E+01'
  read(buf,'(e15.8)',iostat=ios) r13(1)
  write(*,'(a,i4,es25.17e3)') 'READ1  ', ios, r13(1)
  buf = ' 0.10000000-099'
  read(buf,'(e15.8)',iostat=ios) r13(1)
  write(*,'(a,i4,es25.17e3)') 'READ2  ', ios, r13(1)
  buf = '-0.10000000+100'
  read(buf,'(e15.8)',iostat=ios) r13(1)
  write(*,'(a,i4,es25.17e3)') 'READ3  ', ios, r13(1)
  buf = '       12345678'
  read(buf,'(e15.8)',iostat=ios) r13(1)
  write(*,'(a,i4,es25.17e3)') 'READ4  ', ios, r13(1)
  buf = '   1.5         '
  read(buf,'(e15.8)',iostat=ios) r13(1)
  write(*,'(a,i4,es25.17e3)') 'READ5  ', ios, r13(1)
  buf = ' 0.1234D+02    '
  read(buf,'(e15.8)',iostat=ios) r13(1)
  write(*,'(a,i4,es25.17e3)') 'READ6  ', ios, r13(1)
  buf = '   12  3       '
  read(buf,'(e15.8)',iostat=ios) r13(1)
  write(*,'(a,i4,es25.17e3)') 'READ7  ', ios, r13(1)

  ! header of the restart file: initial.f90 reads it with
  ! format('Step #',i4)
  buf = 'Step #  12'
  k = -777
  read(buf,20,iostat=ios) k
  write(*,'(a,i6,i8)') 'RSTEP  ', ios, k
  buf = 'Step #  12'
  k = -777
  read(buf,'(6x,i4)',iostat=ios) k
  write(*,'(a,i6,i8)') 'RSTEP2 ', ios, k
20 format('Step #',i4)

end program format_probe
harness_sources.ptable_probe.f90:
!===============================================================
! Calls the unchanged subroutine ptable (ptable.f90) for every
! two-character name read from standard input and prints the atomic
! weight and the error flag.
!===============================================================
program ptable_probe
  implicit none
  integer, parameter :: dp = kind(1.0d0)
  character(len=2) :: name
  real(dp) :: am
  integer :: ierr, ios

  do
     read(*,'(a2)',iostat=ios) name
     if (ios /= 0) exit
     am = -1.0d0
     ierr = 0
     call ptable(name,am,ierr)
     write(*,'(a,a2,a,es25.17e3,i6)') '|', name, '|', am, ierr
  enddo
end program ptable_probe
harness_sources.gdev_probe.f90:
!===============================================================
! Calls the unchanged functions get_rand_test and gdev of moldyn.f90.
!
! Standard input: mode (1 = uniform numbers, 2 = Gaussian deviates),
! the seed, and how many numbers to print.  Output: one number per line
! with 17 digits, then the final state of mol_dynamic%rng_seed.
!===============================================================
program gdev_probe
  use constants
  use molecular_dynamic_module
  implicit none
  type (molecular_dynamic) :: mol_dynamic
  real(dp), external :: gdev, get_rand_test, getrandom
  integer :: mode, seed, count, i
  real(dp) :: x

  ! mode 3: getrandom, that is the compiler's random_number seeded with
  ! rng_seed and buffered in mol_dynamic%vrandom
  read(*,*) mode, seed, count
  call init_molecular_dynamic(mol_dynamic)
  call molecular_dynamic_turn_on(mol_dynamic,1)
  mol_dynamic%use_test_rng = (mode /= 3)
  mol_dynamic%rng_seed = seed
  do i = 1, count
     if (mode == 1) then
        x = get_rand_test(mol_dynamic)
     else if (mode == 3) then
        x = getrandom(mol_dynamic)
     else
        x = gdev(mol_dynamic)
     endif
     write(*,'(es25.17e3)') x
  enddo
  write(*,'(a,i12)') 'seed ', mol_dynamic%rng_seed
end program gdev_probe
